hypotheses.statement: Shorter titles rank higher in scholarly search engines for typical topical queries.

for.says: rank depends on matches of title terms

hypotheses.statement: Higher retrieval rank translates into more citations at two years.

rivals.statement: Journal prestige drives both short titles (house style) and citations; title length has no effect of its own.
rivals.why_plausible: Prestige explains a large part of the association in the closest work.

repairable_variants.statement: Title informativeness (query-term coverage), not length, drives retrieval.
repairable_variants.repairs: Length may only proxy for term match.
